parameters.content:
## Reset the AR collections demo

Run this before the collections workflow, and any time the demo has drifted.

The invoice due dates are **computed from today**, not stored as fixed dates. That is the difference between a demo that still makes sense next month and one where every invoice is 200 days overdue and the whole dunning ladder collapses into "legal".

It also wipes the collection log, because that log is what the cadence guard reads. A stale log would silently suppress chases that ought to go out.
